description: Retrieves complete specifications, colorways, variant IDs, VAT breakdown, and pricing for a specific product handle or slug. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'get_product_details' on Gear & Glam Store (gearandglam.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'search_products' or 'check_inventory' or 'calculate_order_total' for their respective operations). Parameters: handle (required). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

handle.description: Product handle or slug [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].
